title: OL-20261126-1: Cloudflare migration bundle lacks kernel 0003_focus_log
body:
**Owner:** platform-engineer
**Trigger:** next change to workers/tools/build_migrations.mjs
**Done check:** cmd:node --test workers/core/conformance/l1.test.js
**Prediction:** bundle_missing_kernel_focus_log <= 0 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** renumbering migrations already applied to a deployed database.
**Closing probe:** `node --test workers/core/org/migrations.test.js` (the committed migrations directory equals the build output)
**Status:** done: the builder numbers append-only, so 0003_focus_log ships as 0056_kernel_focus_log.sql and no committed file is renamed

workers/adapters/cloudflare/migrations has drift on main (that tools test fails before this change). A rebuild renumbers 46 files, so 0003_focus_log.sql is held out of the bundle until it can be added without renumbering; setFocus skips the log when the table is absent.
